Our placements have gone well, our coordinators speak highly of working with your department, and we're looking forward to continuing the arrangement into next quarter. I realize you're likely handling a lot of requests this time of year, so thank you in advance for your patience. We're also in the middle of our own year-end reconciliation, so a reply would be a real help.

Kind regards,

tickets.description:
Hi everyone,

I hope you're all doing well. I wanted to give a bit of background first, since I know you get a lot of these. Our team has been using Ironbark Rentals for the equipment on the recent project, and the arrangement has gone smoothly overall. The delivery crew was punctual, the equipment was in good shape, and the account contact there has been very helpful whenever we've had a question. I've been the point of contact on our side since the start, so the vendor tends to come to me first.

Which brings me to why I'm writing. Their invoice 2026-44594 is attached, and I'd like to know whether it has been paid yet, or if not, when it is expected to be paid. They asked me and I couldn't answer.

Sorry for the long note, and thanks for your help. If it's easier to talk it through, I'm happy to hop on a quick call.

Best,
Quinn Brightwater
